---
pagetitle: "Contact · MIDSEA"
page-layout: custom
format:
  html:
    css: theme/midsea.css
    include-in-header:
      - theme/fonts.html
---

```{=html}
<section class="cx-page">

  <!-- ============ HERO ============ -->
  <header class="cx-hero">
    <div class="cx-eye"><span class="dot"></span> Contact · typical reply in ~48h</div>
    <h1 class="cx-h1">
      Say <em>hello</em> —
      <br>or tell us what we're missing.
    </h1>
    <p class="cx-lede">
      MIDSEA is a living, regionally-grounded network. The fastest way to reach us
      is by email — pick the mailbox closest to what you have in mind, and a real
      person (not a shared inbox bot) will write back.
    </p>
  </header>

  <!-- ============ EMAIL CARDS ============ -->
  <div class="cx-mailgrid">

    <a class="cx-mailcard" href="mailto:hello@midsea.network" style="--tc:#7410c6; --tcs:#f2edfa">
      <div class="cx-mailcard-icon" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H8l-5 4V6a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div class="cx-mailcard-body">
        <div class="cx-mailcard-lbl">General</div>
        <div class="cx-mailcard-email">hello@midsea.network</div>
        <div class="cx-mailcard-desc">Questions about the network, joining, or anything we haven't covered.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="cx-mailcard-arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</div>
    </a>

    <a class="cx-mailcard" href="mailto:press@midsea.network" style="--tc:#e3325f; --tcs:#fff0f4">
      <div class="cx-mailcard-icon" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <path d="M3 11v2l4 0 6 5V6L7 11z"/>
          <path d="M16 8a5 5 0 0 1 0 8"/>
          <path d="M19 5a9 9 0 0 1 0 14"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div class="cx-mailcard-body">
        <div class="cx-mailcard-lbl">Press &amp; media</div>
        <div class="cx-mailcard-email">press@midsea.network</div>
        <div class="cx-mailcard-desc">Interview requests, expert comment on outbreaks, or media kit access.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="cx-mailcard-arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</div>
    </a>

    <a class="cx-mailcard" href="mailto:partners@midsea.network" style="--tc:#12a37a; --tcs:#e8f7f0">
      <div class="cx-mailcard-icon" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"/>
          <path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div class="cx-mailcard-body">
        <div class="cx-mailcard-lbl">Partnerships</div>
        <div class="cx-mailcard-email">partners@midsea.network</div>
        <div class="cx-mailcard-desc">Ministries, funders, universities, and collaborative research proposals.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="cx-mailcard-arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</div>
    </a>

  </div>

  <!-- ============ SOCIAL PANEL ============ -->
  <aside class="cx-social">
    <div class="cx-social-intro">
      <div class="cx-eye cx-eye-sub">Follow along</div>
      <h2 class="cx-h2">Find us <em>elsewhere</em></h2>
      <p class="cx-sub">Quiet but steady — we post new papers, school applications, and the occasional field snapshot.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="cx-social-row">
      <a class="cx-social-tile cx-bsky" href="https://bsky.app/profile/midsea.network" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
        <span class="cx-logo" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 600 530" fill="currentColor">
            <path d="M135.72 44.03C202.22 93.95 273.74 195.17 300 249.49c26.26-54.32 97.78-155.54 164.28-205.46C512.26 8.01 590-19.86 590 68.82c0 17.71-10.16 148.79-16.11 170.07-20.7 73.98-96.14 92.85-163.25 81.43 117.3 19.97 147.14 86.09 82.7 152.22-122.4 125.59-175.91-31.51-189.63-71.77-2.51-7.38-3.69-10.83-3.71-7.9-.02-2.93-1.19.52-3.71 7.9-13.71 40.26-67.23 197.36-189.63 71.77-64.44-66.13-34.6-132.25 82.7-152.22-67.11 11.42-142.55-7.45-163.25-81.43C20.15 217.61 10 86.53 10 68.82c0-88.69 77.74-60.82 125.72-24.79z"/>
          </svg>
        </span>
        <div class="cx-social-meta">
          <div class="cx-social-name">Bluesky</div>
          <div class="cx-social-handle">@midsea.network</div>
        </div>
      </a>

      <a class="cx-social-tile cx-gh" href="https://github.com/midsea" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
        <span class="cx-logo" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
            <path d="M12 .297c-6.63 0-12 5.373-12 12 0 5.303 3.438 9.8 8.205 11.385.6.113.82-.258.82-.577 0-.285-.01-1.04-.015-2.04-3.338.724-4.042-1.61-4.042-1.61-.546-1.387-1.335-1.757-1.335-1.757-1.087-.744.084-.729.084-.729 1.205.084 1.838 1.236 1.838 1.236 1.07 1.835 2.809 1.305 3.495.998.108-.776.417-1.305.76-1.605-2.665-.3-5.466-1.332-5.466-5.93 0-1.31.465-2.38 1.235-3.22-.135-.303-.54-1.523.105-3.176 0 0 1.005-.322 3.3 1.23.96-.267 1.98-.399 3-.405 1.02.006 2.04.138 3 .405 2.28-1.552 3.285-1.23 3.285-1.23.645 1.653.24 2.873.12 3.176.765.84 1.23 1.91 1.23 3.22 0 4.61-2.805 5.625-5.475 5.92.42.36.81 1.096.81 2.22 0 1.606-.015 2.896-.015 3.286 0 .315.21.69.825.57C20.565 22.092 24 17.592 24 12.297c0-6.627-5.373-12-12-12"/>
          </svg>
        </span>
        <div class="cx-social-meta">
          <div class="cx-social-name">GitHub</div>
          <div class="cx-social-handle">github.com/midsea</div>
        </div>
      </a>

      <a class="cx-social-tile cx-li" href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/midsea-network" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
        <span class="cx-logo" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
            <path d="M20.447 20.452h-3.554v-5.569c0-1.328-.027-3.037-1.852-3.037-1.853 0-2.136 1.445-2.136 2.939v5.667H9.351V9h3.414v1.561h.046c.477-.9 1.637-1.85 3.37-1.85 3.601 0 4.267 2.37 4.267 5.455v6.286zM5.337 7.433c-1.144 0-2.063-.926-2.063-2.065 0-1.138.92-2.063 2.063-2.063 1.14 0 2.064.925 2.064 2.063 0 1.139-.925 2.065-2.064 2.065zm1.782 13.019H3.555V9h3.564v11.452zM22.225 0H1.771C.792 0 0 .774 0 1.729v20.542C0 23.227.792 24 1.771 24h20.451C23.2 24 24 23.227 24 22.271V1.729C24 .774 23.2 0 22.222 0h.003z"/>
          </svg>
        </span>
        <div class="cx-social-meta">
          <div class="cx-social-name">LinkedIn</div>
          <div class="cx-social-handle">MIDSEA Network</div>
        </div>
      </a>
    </div>
  </aside>

  <!-- ============ FOOTER NOTE ============ -->
  <footer class="cx-foot">
    <div class="cx-foot-mark" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 60 60">
        <circle cx="18" cy="24" r="10" fill="#7410c6" opacity="0.75"/>
        <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="12" fill="#e3325f" opacity="0.75"/>
        <circle cx="44" cy="22" r="8"  fill="#12a37a" opacity="0.75"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="cx-foot-title">Prefer post?</div>
      <div class="cx-foot-body">
        MIDSEA Network · c/o NUS Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health ·
        12 Science Drive 2, Singapore 117549
      </div>
    </div>
  </footer>

</section>

<style>
  :root {
    --cx-ink: #1a0f36;
    --cx-ink-2: #4a4060;
    --cx-ink-3: #8a839f;
    --cx-line: #e8e4f1;
    --cx-line-2: #d9d2ea;
    --cx-primary: #7410c6;
  }

  .cx-page {
    font-family: "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif;
    color: var(--cx-ink);
    background: #fff;
    padding: clamp(48px, 8vw, 96px) clamp(20px, 5vw, 80px) 80px;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  /* ============ Shared atoms ============ */
  .cx-eye {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
    font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--cx-ink-2);
    margin-bottom: 22px;
  }
  .cx-eye .dot {
    width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--cx-primary);
    animation: cx-pulse 2.4s infinite;
  }
  @keyframes cx-pulse { 0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(116,16,198,.55)} 80%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(116,16,198,0)} 100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(116,16,198,0)} }

  .cx-h1 {
    font-family: "Space Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 4.8rem);
    line-height: 1.02;
    letter-spacing: -0.035em;
    margin: 0 0 22px;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  .cx-h1 em, .cx-h2 em {
    font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif;
    font-style: italic; font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--cx-primary);
  }
  .cx-h2 {
    font-family: "Space Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.6rem);
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
    line-height: 1.05;
    margin: 0 0 10px;
  }
  .cx-lede {
    font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif;
    font-size: clamp(19px, 2vw, 24px);
    line-height: 1.45;
    max-width: 58ch;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--cx-ink);
  }
  .cx-sub {
    font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--cx-ink-2);
    margin: 0; max-width: 48ch;
  }

  /* ============ Hero ============ */
  .cx-hero { margin-bottom: 64px; max-width: 72ch; }

  /* ============ Mail grid ============ */
  .cx-mailgrid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 72px;
  }
  .cx-mailcard {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr 24px;
    gap: 18px;
    align-items: start;
    padding: 26px 24px;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--cx-line);
    border-radius: 22px;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),
                border-color 220ms, box-shadow 220ms;
  }
  .cx-mailcard::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute;
    top: -40px; right: -40px;
    width: 140px; height: 140px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--tc); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 300ms;
  }
  .cx-mailcard:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    border-color: var(--tc);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -24px color-mix(in oklab, var(--tc) 60%, transparent);
  }
  .cx-mailcard:hover::before { opacity: 0.08; }
  .cx-mailcard-icon {
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 16px;
    background: var(--tcs);
    color: var(--tc);
    display: grid; place-items: center;
    transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
  }
  .cx-mailcard-icon svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; }
  .cx-mailcard:hover .cx-mailcard-icon { transform: rotate(-4deg) scale(1.06); }
  .cx-mailcard-body { position: relative; z-index: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .cx-mailcard-lbl {
    font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
    font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--cx-ink-3); margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .cx-mailcard-email {
    font-family: "Space Grotesk", sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(17px, 1.4vw, 20px);
    font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.015em;
    color: var(--cx-ink);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    word-break: break-word;
  }
  .cx-mailcard:hover .cx-mailcard-email { color: var(--tc); }
  .cx-mailcard-desc {
    font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--cx-ink-2);
  }
  .cx-mailcard-arrow {
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    font-size: 18px; color: var(--cx-ink-3);
    transition: transform 220ms, color 220ms;
    align-self: center;
  }
  .cx-mailcard:hover .cx-mailcard-arrow { transform: translateX(6px); color: var(--tc); }

  /* ============ Social panel ============ */
  .cx-social {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.4fr);
    gap: clamp(32px, 5vw, 64px);
    align-items: center;
    padding: 40px clamp(24px, 4vw, 48px);
    border-radius: 28px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(80% 120% at 0% 0%, rgba(116,16,198,0.07), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(80% 120% at 100% 100%, rgba(242,201,76,0.10), transparent 60%),
      #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--cx-line);
    margin-bottom: 64px;
  }
  .cx-eye-sub { margin-bottom: 14px; }

  .cx-social-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 14px;
  }
  .cx-social-tile {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 22px 14px;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--cx-line);
    border-radius: 18px;
    text-decoration: none; color: inherit;
    transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),
                border-color 220ms, box-shadow 220ms, background 220ms;
  }
  .cx-social-tile:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow: 0 18px 34px -22px rgba(26,15,54,0.35);
  }
  .cx-logo {
    width: 44px; height: 44px;
    display: grid; place-items: center;
    border-radius: 12px;
    transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
  }
  .cx-logo svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; display: block; }
  .cx-social-tile:hover .cx-logo { transform: scale(1.1); }

  /* Platform-specific logo colours on hover */
  .cx-bsky .cx-logo { background: #eaf4ff; color: #1185fe; }
  .cx-bsky:hover   { border-color: #1185fe; }
  .cx-gh   .cx-logo { background: #f0eef3; color: #1a0f36; }
  .cx-gh:hover     { border-color: #1a0f36; }
  .cx-li   .cx-logo { background: #e8f1f8; color: #0a66c2; }
  .cx-li:hover     { border-color: #0a66c2; }

  .cx-social-name {
    font-family: "Space Grotesk", sans-serif;
    font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    color: var(--cx-ink); text-align: center;
  }
  .cx-social-handle {
    font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
    font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: var(--cx-ink-3); text-align: center;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  /* ============ Footer note ============ */
  .cx-foot {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 60px 1fr;
    gap: 20px; align-items: center;
    padding: 20px 24px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--cx-line);
    padding-top: 28px;
  }
  .cx-foot-mark svg { width: 60px; height: 60px; display: block; }
  .cx-foot-title {
    font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
    font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--cx-ink-3); margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .cx-foot-body {
    font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif;
    font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.45;
    color: var(--cx-ink-2);
  }

  /* ============ Responsive ============ */
  @media (max-width: 960px) {
    .cx-mailgrid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .cx-social { grid-template-columns: 1fr; text-align: left; padding: 32px 24px; }
    .cx-social-row { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  }
  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .cx-social-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .cx-mailcard { grid-template-columns: 48px 1fr 20px; gap: 14px; padding: 22px 18px; }
    .cx-mailcard-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 14px; }
    .cx-mailcard-icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  }
</style>
```
